'''Dwanar Gher''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who operated during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Gher was an associate of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Nanika Senoj]] and around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Gher and Senoj were approached by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Unko]] while in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] on the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], who attempted to hire them to deliver so contraband to [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]]. Gher and Senoj declined the offer, because they were wanted by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], and Unko instead paid the Sullustan to find him someone who could take on the assignment. Gher attempted to persuade the smuggler [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] to accept the job, but Rendar declined because [[Outrider/Legends|his starship]] was in need of repairs.
